$comment: Product identity, in one place. Renaming the distribution is an edit here plus `pnpm run package:darwin-arm64`; nothing else hardcodes these strings.
name: dsh-foundry
$publisherNote: Becomes the CompanyName in the Windows executable version resource and the author of the packaged manifest. It names whoever publishes THIS distribution, never DeepSeek: the product states it is unaffiliated, and a Windows binary claiming otherwise in its file properties would contradict that where a user is most likely to check.
$bundleIdNote: Reverse-DNS of a domain the publisher controls. macOS does not verify ownership for an unsigned build, but a signed release and any future notarization do, and a bundle id on someone else's domain collides with their apps in Launch Services.
$repositoryNote: Canonical public repository for this distribution.
